correctness.rationale: For stable 0<u<1, normal-mode diagonalization gives OU rates 1±u and isotropic circle reset marks with exact mixed fourth mark moment R^4/8. The stationary generator closes on M_+, M_- and M_22, and centered squared modes are exact regression eigenfunctions at rates r+2(1±u). Algebraic subtraction yields K(r), checked by 180 exact-rational cases and 7 independent age-integral quadratures. The strictly decreasing sign bracket and its discriminant prove the two disjoint radius windows, unique positive root, all boundaries and high-r limit; nine independent temporal comparisons corroborate regression. Finite tests are not proof of the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The model is directly motivated by a newly published circular-reset gyrator. Linear normal-mode cross correlations vanish at every lag and ordinary mean angular momentum vanishes at equal bath temperatures, yet a measurable fourth-order chronological asymmetry remains. Its exact direction reverses at one tunable reset rate precisely in two nontrivial circle-radius windows; outside them its sign is rigid. The result isolates competition between positive common reset-age correlations and negative geometric energy anticorrelation of a fixed-radius mark and supplies sharp experimental diagnostics. It does not infer physical entropy production from the correlator sign alone.
